tools.name: list_resolved_batches
tools.description:
List graded books, newest first, one summary row each: date, returns, alpha against SPY and RSP, and verdict.
    A book (or batch) is one trading day's full S&P 500 slate. Use this to find a trading_date, then get_resolved_batch
    for every forecast in that book or verify_batch for its proof. Dat

tools.name: get_resolved_batch
tools.description:
Get one graded book with every forecast and its outcome. A book (or batch) is one trading day's full S&P 500
    slate, served once its long picks are fully graded, so other rows can still have null outcomes. Use
    list_resolved_batches to find the date, verify_batch for the book's proof and get_b

tools.name: get_track_record_stats
tools.description:
Get aggregates computed only from fully resolved books: forecast counts, returns and hit rates, and how many
    books beat, matched (flat) or trailed SPY, each book's verdict graded on its cap-weighted long picks. The hit
    rates count the books graded under the published rule, from published_rul

tools.name: get_calibration
tools.description:
Check whether forecasts matched outcomes: mean predicted against mean realized return by decile across every
    graded book, and hit rates by rank bucket and by side (long or short) across books graded under the published rule.
    Use this to judge how well the ranking held up, and get_track_recor

tools.name: get_universe_and_scoring_spec
tools.description:
Get the versioned scoring rules, the metric definitions and the latest graded book's universe of stocks.
    Use this before interpreting a stat or a verdict, to learn how books are graded and which stocks are covered.

tools.name: get_stock_resolved_history
tools.description:
Get one stock's rows from graded books only, newest first: its forecast, rank, pick side and outcome in each
    book. Use this to follow one ticker across books, explain_resolved_prediction for the evidence behind one row, and
    get_resolved_batch for a whole book. An unknown ticker returns an em

tools.name: get_book_portfolio
tools.description:
Get a resolved book's portfolio: market-cap-weighted vs SPY ("cap", the default, the portfolio the ledger's
    verdict grades) or equal-weighted vs RSP ("equal"), with each long pick's weight and graded return, the book
    return, the benchmark return and its evidence, alpha and verdict. Equal wei

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description:
Find the developer guides and site pages that match a few words. Each
    hit carries the page title, its canonical URL and a short excerpt. Use this
    for how Timefire works and what its terms mean, not for record data. No
    match returns an empty list, so try other words.

tools.name: get_simulation_nav
tools.description:
Get the paper portfolio's daily value (NAV), market-cap-weighted vs SPY ("cap", the default) or equal-weighted
    vs RSP ("equal"), with both benchmarks on every row. There is one row per resolved trading day. The series stops at

tools.name: get_simulation_trades
tools.description:
Get the paper portfolio's closed trades from resolved books, newest first, market-cap-weighted ("cap", the
    default) or equal-weighted ("equal"): the two trade at the same prices and differ in weight, and so in size and
    P&L. Open positions never appear. Date bounds apply to the day a trade op

tools.name: explain_resolved_prediction
tools.description:
Get the stored evidence behind one stock's forecast in a graded book: its rank, side, market regime, 5- and
    20-day lookback returns, news items and notes. Use this to see the context a stock was ranked in, and
    get_stock_resolved_history to find which books hold it. An ungraded date, or a tic

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_book_portfolio" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
